title: feat(wire): group independently captured punches in one native job
body:
Stacked on #2972. Review the [changes above the parent](https://github.com/qsmits/Camcraft/compare/f99a9d736...issue/2961-agie-multiple-works).

Process change: yes

## What changed

This PR posts two independently captured punches on one 20 mm plate as one native wire EDM job. It is ported onto the zero-step setup writer of #2984 and onto the #2955, #2964, #2968, #2969 and #2972 ports. The old branch wrote its own SBL through `jescript.rs`. That writer is deleted on main, and this port does not use it.

- **Piece writer (post).** `agie_setup/piece.rs` now takes one `Piece` (stem, stock, height) and a list of `Work` (ISO stem, side, start point, exit point). It writes one quality `CCB030`, one group and the works `CUT1..n` in a loop. Each work refers to the same quality object (`ID_QUALITY,je_q1`) and has its own `ID_GEOMETRY`, `stp1` and `ASDELETE` call. The single-work SBL is byte-identical to before.
- **Group setup (post).** The new `agie_setup::PunchGroup20` takes the group stem, the stock, the 20 mm height and two `GroupPunch` entries (ISO stem and start hole). It refuses another number of works, a repeated or invalid ISO stem, a height other than 20 mm, stock outside the 350 × 250 mm span and a hole that is not completely inside the stock. The SBR has one resource line for each ISO.
- **Group export (post).** `agie::export_group_with_review` sends one job to `export_with_review` unchanged. Two jobs must be closed punches on the same 20 mm stock with a separation of 1.0 mm, and the job name has at most seven characters. Each work passes the full single-punch checks. The two cutting areas must have a clear band along X or Y. Each area includes the solid, the hole, the 3 mm lead, the longest rough miter (at least the rough offset of the thickness) and the 0.125 mm wire radius. The job has `<name>1.ISO`, `<name>2.ISO`, one SBR and one SBL, published in one directory rename.
- **App.** The post takes one or two active Wire Contour operations. Two operations must use the same setup and wire tool. Each must select a different complete modeled punch, and no other model can be present (`posting_agie_group.rs`). `agie_job` now receives its source model from the caller.
- **Docs and example.** New user-guide section "Group two captured punches", the example `examples/agie/punch-pair.camscript` (two models, `PAIR20`) and the decision file `docs/decisions/2961-agie-punch-group.md`.

## Setup fields and their sources

- All work fields are those of the control-checked zero-step punch of #2984 (golden `CCSEP20.SBL`). Only the work name, `ID_GEOMETRY` and the `stp1` position change for each work.
- The quality is created one time for the piece, as in #2984. The old branch created `QN2` and `QN3`, one name for each work. #2984 found that the control can bind different quality names to different resident data.
- One ISO for each work, the geometry, the stock (80 × 60 × 20 mm) and the holes (X-30 Y0 and X1 Y0) are those of this PR's original control-checked pair.

## Readings

- `PAIR20` from `camcraft-cli script examples/agie/punch-pair.camscript`: four files. The SBL is byte-identical to the new golden `PAIR20.SBL`.
- Emulated Agie Classic Cut 2S (offline clone of the practice control, deleted after the run):
  - The ISO and SBL bytes on the control disk match the export.
  - After import: `CUT1 CCB030[0] stp1 PAIR201.ISO` and `CUT2 CCB030[0] stp1 PAIR202.ISO`. FORMALCHECK gives one "Technologie : te definiëren" error for each work.
  - Each work shows CCB030 with Ra 0.30, Tkm 1.0 and Te 1.5 and both options off. The CUT2 start point is X1.000 Y0.000, diameter 2.0.
  - TECCUT gives the row `0199` (Dia 0.25, H20, Ra 0.30) and the technology `estbca25nnn060b030020` on both works. The offsets are 245, 155, 140 and 134 µm on each work. The tree then shows `CCB030[4]` on each work.
  - FORMALCHECK after TECCUT: "Controleresultaat: geen fouten" for the piece and for each work. Warnings: "Uitgekozen opties : 131072" and "Referentiewaarden : te definiëren" on each work, and "Bewerkingen : te definiëren" on the piece. A single-work job of the same frame (`SOLO20`) gives the same piece warnings.
  - GRAFICHECK: 16 cut blocks. The control cuts the four profile passes of CUT1, then of CUT2, then the four separation passes of CUT1, then of CUT2. Each separation is 1.000 mm. The moves between the works are only transit blocks (`TRA`, G00 with the head up). The cutting envelopes are CUT1 X-30.000..-9.755 Y-8.245..8.245 and CUT2 X1.000..24.245 Y-7.245..9.245. They do not touch.
- No physical cut was made.

## Pinning tests

- `camcraft-post` `agie_safe_setup` (module `group`): `group_files_match_the_zero_step_punch_pair` (golden `PAIR20.SBL` and `PAIR20.SBR`), `each_work_has_its_own_geometry_side_and_hole`, `each_work_of_a_group_has_the_records_of_a_single_punch`, `a_group_refuses_its_unqualified_inputs`.
- `camcraft-post` lib `agie::group_tests`: `a_punch_pair_writes_an_iso_a_resource_line_a_work_and_a_hole_for_each_punch`, `a_single_work_through_the_group_export_keeps_its_bytes` (equal to `CCSEP20.SBL`), `a_group_rejects_an_unqualified_height_or_reserved_geometry_alias`, `a_group_refuses_a_die_three_works_another_stock_or_no_separation`, `the_band_between_punches_includes_the_rough_corner_lead_and_wire`.
- `camcraft-app` `agie_native`: `group::the_two_model_owners_have_distinct_programs_holes_and_captures`, `group::a_shared_source_an_unowned_model_or_a_crossing_thread_path_writes_nothing`.
- The goldens that main already has (CCSEP20, DIE20 and the inspection goldens) do not change. Other goldens are listed in "Goldens moved". Existing tests pass unchanged.

## Gate (head `0f39ce973`)

The head merges `origin/main` at `aedd9750c`, which has the fix of #3774.

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 526 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (56.0 min). All `agie*` suites, `example_catalog*` and the `post`, `app` and `ui` lib tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test agie_safe_setup`: 16 passed.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main`: clean.
- No heavy step: this PR is not `P1`.

## Not exercised

- No physical cut.
- Groups of more than two works, a die or an open cutoff in a group, and heights other than 20 mm are refused. No control run covers them.
- The band check can refuse some safe nested or diagonal layouts.
- The GUI was not run. The post is the same as the CLI post.

Changelog: The native wire EDM job files post groups two independently captured punches on one 20 mm plate in one job, after it checks that their complete cutting areas stay apart.

## UI screenshots

This PR contains the two open-cutoff controls of #2972 on the Wire Contour Passes tab. One pair of images covers all five PRs of the stack. The reviewer rendered the images with the crate's egui_kittest harness.

Before (main):

![Before: Wire Contour Passes tab on main](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-before.png?raw=true)

After (with the two cutoff controls):

![After: Wire Contour Passes tab with the two cutoff controls](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/blob/pr-screenshots/pr-2972/wire-open-cutoff-after.png?raw=true)

## Goldens moved

The golden files below are additions relative to main. This PR changes no golden file that main already has. The goldens CCSEP20 and DIE20 of main do not change.

- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/LOWER20.SBL` (A): pins the open-cutoff (zero-step, one cut) setup SBL. Added by #2972 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/PAIR20.SBL` (A): pins the SBL of a group of two punches on one plate. Added by #2974 of the stack.
- `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/PAIR20.SBR` (A): pins the SBR of a group of two punches on one plate. Added by #2974 of the stack.

## Test layout

This PR adds no new top-level test binary. The new post setup tests are modules of an existing suite. The test count did not change.

- `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs` (from #2972) moved to `crates/post/tests/agie_safe_setup/cutoff.rs`: module `cutoff` of `agie_safe_setup`, 4 tests.
- `crates/post/tests/agie_group_setup.rs` moved to `crates/post/tests/agie_safe_setup/group.rs`: module `group` of `agie_safe_setup`, 4 tests. The suite now has 16 tests (8 + 4 + 4).
- The tests are unchanged except for the golden paths (`../golden/`). The Gate map of `agie_safe_setup` covers `camcraft_post::agie_setup`, so the quick gate selects the suite for a change in the setup writer.
- The app tests of this PR were already the module `group` of `agie_native`.
